name: manual_61e28f
claim: Koan — skill-security wording: To teach what must not be run, do not write it where it will be run. The forbidden command belongs in the quarantined curriculum (skillify/examples/bad/ with aguara-ignore-next-line per bad line), not on the operator cheat sheet (SKILL.md). Euphemism teaches nothing; literal bad examples behind explicit scanner ignore teach everything — without weakening CI or handing naive agents a remote-control script.

decisions.notes: User-requested koan distilling the PR #222 meta-lesson: scanners and naive agents both treat skill markdown as executable; two-layer doctrine + quarantined curriculum resolves the paradox that you cannot teach the negative rule in production skill files.
